name: Adaptive Binoctree Sampling
definition: A sampling strategy for optimizing neural implicit SDFs from omnidirectional video that uses a pre-built spherical binoctree to guide ray sampling. It densifies samples near the surface by subdividing sphoxels based on solid angle and distance, using coarse and fine sphoxels to guide sampling instead of standard importance sampling.
summary: Adaptive Binoctree Sampling optimizes neural SDFs by using a hierarchical spherical binoctree to guide ray sampling, replacing standard importance sampling for superior surface localization in large unbounded scenes.
